body:
selfhost/emit.prn now correctly returns a struct-typed field directly (unboxed) when it's the whole body of a struct-returning function, closing the last gap struct-return-type support left open. get-field's own tail-position dispatch previously always boxed via emit-i32-boxed, invalid C for a real struct value -- fixed with a narrow, special-cased check in emit-defn (using its own already-known declared return type) rather than threading struct-type-awareness through emit-form's whole recursive machinery. 7 new tests including a real compile+run+assert check plus a direct regression guard proving the pre-existing scalar-field case is unchanged. Zero regressions: 336-test suite + all 6 selfhost domains + bazel build/test clean. PARENA commit 4fe81e0.

⚓ ☃
title: Self-hosted compiler: struct-typed field as a tail-position return
